analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 42.3 is exiting oversold but remains neutral. MACD histogram shows improvement (-1972.2513 → 87.7348), signaling bottoming. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 187,000 KRW and current price at 206,000 KRW. Volume is subdued at 0.69x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in directional moves. The price is near the 20-day moving average at 214,125 KRW, facing resistance at the swing resistance level of 209,000 KRW. Confirmation is needed for a clear direction. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session.
